rationale: A clean single-knob horizon extension of the archive's strongest result with a coherent smoothing rationale and a genuine coverage argument; the only caveat is that the three-year denominator still drops permanent non-payers, so the expected coverage gain may be smaller than claimed.

target_name: Sector relative payout mix when cheap
rationale: Economically well-motivated (payout instrument conventions are strongly sector-determined) and internally consistent, but it is a one-operator substitution on the archive's winner and therefore delivers only incremental information relative to Proposal 1.

target_name: Buyback over dividend intensity when cheap
rationale: A legitimate composition-versus-magnitude diagnostic, but since dividends are small relative to repurchases for most firms, (prstkc − dvt)/at collapses to plain repurchase intensity, making this close to the well-known net-repurchase/payout-yield anomaly interacted with earnings yield and near-adjacent to the archive's "Industry neutral cheap repurchaser."

target_name: Equity versus debt retirement when cheap
rationale: A genuinely different decision margin with a bounded, size-neutral construction, but the economic story is weakened by dltr being largely non-discretionary (scheduled maturities, revolver repayments), so the ratio may measure debt-structure mechanics rather than a relative-value choice between claims.

target_name: Pecking order choice at a discount
rationale: Extending instrument choice to the raising side is a sensible, non-duplicative test on a disjoint firm subsample, though dltis is heavily contaminated by revolver draws and rollovers, and the low-earnings-yield leg risks re-expressing the published equity-issuance anomaly through a different scaling.

target_name: Buyback tilted payout among expensive firms
rationale: The stated design ("both legs drawn from the same glamour segment, free of value loading") contradicts what the expression computes — gating produces exact zeros for ~70% of firms, so the short leg is dominated by ungated non-glamour names — and the same INDICATOR-gated glamour cell was already tested in the archive with the opposite expected sign and a mildly positive slope.
